name: Workplace: co-working
about: A flexible workspace let by the desk and by the room: hot desks and dedicated desks in the open, private team offices of several sizes, a community cafe at the front, an event space, many phone booths. In three parts: the Workplace: co-working typology (on the Workplace one), an office fit-out on an RCC shell, and the BuilderPluss standards with the Indian codes. 2.2.0: its glazed walls in the versions that say they let light through (R160); nothing else changed.
